updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
BETA 3.1.3.2 
- OpenKneeboard OUt now groups keywords in row across format to keep similar comands at the top of the window. 
- OpenKneeboard OUT F-4E keywords now have phase of flight handlingbased on last sent command. 
- OpenKneeboard OUT pages refresh on any passed command without requirening the Page Command. 
- Add WSO commands for fuel managment, tanker or airfield divert also add display support. 
- Add WSO commands Radar Lock Target, and Radar Focus target [1-20] to Openkeeboard commands list. 
- Add Plugin controls for OpenKneeboard OUT tab browsing for use in Voice Attack 'execute an external plugin command'.
